dod_intent_evidence: Own site: 'Compound Eye has won five Direct to Phase 2 SBIR awards from the US Department of Defense to adapt VIDAS for warfighters' (homepage/applications), corroborated by Army SBIR CATALYST $13.3M news (2025).
score_evidence: 'Tens of millions of depth measurements per second without LiDAR or radar' → lab_language_intensity
'True 3D measurements at 20 Hz... Accuracy within 1% of LiDAR' plus a whole 'Demo Gallery' section → lab_language_intensity

SWaP fluency exists ('fraction of the size, weight, power, and cost, all with zero signature' — sbir_abstract) but zero ATO/RMF/CMMC/ITAR language anywhere → deployment_awareness_absence held moderate
Hiring 'Field Robotics Engineer' (x3) alongside ML researchers — field roles present, but no compliance/ISSO/deployment roles → hiring_profile_skew 8

blind_spots.blind_spot: Dev-kit power and compute budget does not fit the small unmanned platforms the Army/AF money is for
blind_spots.operator_reality: A Group 1/2 UAS or dismounted kit has single-digit watts to spare; a perception stack characterized at ~30W on 12VDC either kills endurance or gets left at the FOB.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The company is automotive-first; its published specs are for cars and heavy equipment, and the AF abstract itself admits the current stereo baseline 'is not suitable for small unmanned platforms.'
blind_spots.evidence_quote: The system is powered by 12VDC and draws approximately 30W during data collection.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Tooling assumes connectivity a DDIL environment denies
blind_spots.operator_reality: Data collection, model updates, and analysis that run through browser/cloud tools stop working at an austere OCONUS site with intermittent comms — same failure family as the 30fps crowd-detection case, here hitting the sustainment loop instead of the sensor feed.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Their customers to date are commercial dev teams on networks; nothing in their language mentions disconnected operation or on-prem retraining.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: browser-based tools for data collection, inspection, and analysis, and an SDK for building applications on top of VIDAS

blind_spots.blind_spot: Sells situational awareness to Army units with no TAK story and no ATO path
blind_spots.operator_reality: For VIDAS output to reach a soldier or a fires cell it must land in ATAK/TAK and the hosting software must clear RMF/ATO on the platform's network; neither ATAK, ATO, RMF, nor STIG appears in ~1,200 words of their language while $13.3M of CATALYST transition money is on the clock.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Perception-stack engineers treat integration and accreditation as the customer's problem; DIU-style prototyping lets you defer it until it kills the transition.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Track your position even when GPS is unreliable or denied.

opener_hook: Compound Eye's AFRL Phase II promises to 'train AF Customers' on a monocular VIDAS — the $13.3M CATALYST clock now makes who fields it, on what power budget, the whole game.
what_they_do: Camera-only 3D perception software (depth, scene understanding, GPS-denied positioning) for autonomous vehicles, being adapted to military UAS and ground autonomy.
